title: Song of Solomon
author: Traditionally associated with Solomon.
date: Part of Israel's wisdom and poetic literature.
audience: God's people, celebrating covenant love, marital desire, beauty, and faithfulness.
historicalSetting: Song of Solomon is poetic celebration of love between bride and bridegroom, honoring the goodness of love within God's design.
keyVerse: Song of Solomon 8:7 — "Many waters can't quench love, neither can floods drown it."
christFocus: Song of Solomon celebrates covenant love and, by biblical analogy, can lift the heart to consider Christ's faithful love for His bride, the church.
